en.headline: Russia questions Dutch role in Crimean Bridge strike
en.body: Russia’s embassy in the Netherlands asked whether The Hague was openly joining the war after Dutch-headquartered defense company Destinus said its Ruta missiles struck the Crimean Bridge. The Dutch company confirmed the strike on the bridge linking annexed Crimea to Russia.

es.headline: Rusia cuestiona el papel holandés en el ataque al puente de Crimea
es.body: La embajada de Rusia en los Países Bajos preguntó si La Haya se estaba sumiendo abiertamente en la guerra tras confirmarse que la empresa holandesa Destinus, con sede en La Haya, disparó misiles Ruta contra el puente de Crimea. La empresa holandesa confirmó el ataque al puente que une Crimea anexionada con Rusia.

de.headline: Russland hinterfragt niederländische Rolle bei Krim-Brückenanschlag
de.body: Die russische Botschaft in den Niederlanden fragte, ob Den Haag offen am Krieg teilnimmt, nachdem die in Den Haag ansässige Rüstungsfirma Destinus bekannt gab, ihre Ruta-Raketen hätten die Krim-Brücke getroffen. Das niederländische Unternehmen bestätigte den Schlag auf die Brücke, die annektiertes Krim mit Russland verbindet.

fr.headline: La Russie interroge le rôle néerlandais dans l'attaque du pont de Crimée
fr.body: L'ambassade de Russie aux Pays-Bas s'est interrogée sur la volonté d'Hague de s'engager ouvertement dans la guerre après qu'une entreprise de défense néerlandaise basée à La Haye, Destinus, a affirmé avoir frappé le pont de Crimée. L'entreprise néerlandaise a confirmé l'attaque sur le pont reliant la Crimée annexée à la Russie.

it.headline: La Russia mette in dubbio il ruolo olandese nell'attacco al ponte di Crimea
it.body: L'ambasciata russa nei Paesi Bassi ha chiesto se L'Aia stesse aderendo apertamente alla guerra dopo che l'azienda olandese Destinus, con sede a L'Aia, ha dichiarato che i suoi missili Ruta avevano colpito il ponte di Crimea. L'azienda olandese ha confermato l'attacco al ponte che collega la Crimea annessa alla Russia.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯质疑荷兰在克里米亚大桥袭击中的角色
zh.body: 俄罗斯驻荷兰使馆询问海牙是否公开加入战争，原因是总部位于荷兰的国防公司Destinus声称其Ruta导弹袭击了克里米亚大桥。该荷兰公司确认了对连接被吞并的克里米亚与俄罗斯的大桥的袭击。

ko.headline: 러시아, 네덜란드의 크림대교 공격 역할 질문
ko.body: 러시아 네덜란드 대사관이 헤이그가 개전 직전에 가세했는지 묻자, 네덜란드 본사 방산기업 디스티누스가 크림대교를 타격한 루타 미사일을 발사했다고 확인했다.

ja.headline: ロシア、オランダのクリミア橋攻撃における役割を問う
ja.body: ロシアのオランダ大使館は、オランダ本社の防衛企業デスティヌスがクリミア橋にルタミサイルを撃ち込んだ後、ハーグが開戦に加わったかと問いかけた。オランダ企業はクリミア橋への攻撃を確認した。

pt.headline: Rússia questiona papel holandês no ataque à Ponte da Crimeia
pt.body: Embaixada da Rússia nos Países Baixos questionou se Haia estava a ingressar abertamente na guerra após a empresa de defesa sediada em Haia, Destinus, afirmar que os mísseis Ruta atingiram a Ponte da Crimeia. A empresa holandesa confirmou o ataque à ponte que liga a Crimeia anexada à Rússia.

en.headline: EU proposes 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine to be repaid from Russian reparations
en.body: The European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine for 2027, to be repaid through future Russian war reparations. The plan splits the funds evenly between defense and state budget spending. According to the Commission, the money would come from interest on the EU budget.

fr.headline: L'Union européenne propose un prêt de 45 milliards d'euros pour l'Ukraine, remboursable à partir des réparations russes
fr.body: La Commission européenne a proposé un nouveau prêt de 45 milliards d'euros pour l'Ukraine en 2027, à rembourser via les futures réparations de guerre russes. Le plan répartit les fonds à parts égales entre les dépenses de défense et le budget de l'État. Selon la Commission, l'argent proviendrait des intérêts du budget de l'UE.

it.headline: UE propone prestito da 45 miliardi di euro per l'Ucraina da rimborsare dai risarcimenti russi
it.body: La Commissione europea ha proposto un nuovo prestito da 45 miliardi di euro per l'Ucraina per il 2027, da rimborsare attraverso i futuri risarcimenti di guerra russi. Il piano ripartisce i fondi in modo equo tra spese per la difesa e spese per il bilancio statale. Secondo la Commissione, i fondi deriverebbero dagli interessi del bilancio UE.

es.headline: La UE propone un préstamo de 45.000 millones de euros para Ucrania a devolver con reparaciones rusas
es.body: La Comisión Europea propuso un nuevo préstamo de 45.000 millones de euros para Ucrania para 2027, a devolver a través de futuras reparaciones de guerra rusas. El plan reparte los fondos equitativamente entre gasto en defensa y gasto en el presupuesto estatal. Según la Comisión, el dinero procedería de los intereses del presupuesto de la UE.

pt.headline: UE propõe empréstimo de 45 mil milhões de euros para a Ucrânia a ser reembolsado a partir de reparações russas
pt.body: A Comissão Europeia propôs um novo empréstimo de 45 mil milhões de euros para a Ucrânia para 2027, a ser reembolsado através de futuras reparações de guerra russas. O plano divide os fundos igualmente entre despesas de defesa e despesas orçamentais do Estado. Segundo a Comissão, o dinheiro provém dos juros do orçamento da UE.

zh.headline: 欧盟提议450亿欧元贷款援助乌克兰，计划从俄赔偿中偿还
zh.body: 欧盟委员会提议为2027年向乌克兰提供新的450亿欧元贷款，计划将偿还工作通过未来的俄战争赔偿来完成。该方案将资金均匀分配至国防和国家预算支出。根据委员会称，资金将来源于欧盟预算的利息。

de.headline: EU schlägt 45-Milliarden-Euro-Kredit für Ukraine vor, der von russischen Reparationen zurückgezahlt werden soll
de.body: Die Europäische Kommission hat einen neuen Kredit in Höhe von 45 Milliarden Euro für die Ukraine für 2027 vorgeschlagen, der künftig über russische Kriegsschulden zurückgezahlt werden soll. Der Plan teilt die Mittel gleichmäßig zwischen Verteidigung und Staatsausgaben auf. Laut Kommission soll das Geld aus Zinseinnahmen des EU-Haushalts stammen.

ko.headline: EU, 우크라이나에 450억 유로 대출 제안…러시아 재산으로 상환
ko.body: 유럽위원회가 2027년 우크라이나를 위해 450억 유로의 새로운 대출을 제안했으며, 이는 미래 러시아 전쟁 배상금으로 상환된다. 계획은 자금을 방어와 국가 예산 지출에 균등하게 분배한다. 위원회에 따르면 자금은 EU 예자의 이자에서 나올 것이다.

ja.headline: EU、ロシアの賠償金から返済されるウクライナ向け450億ユーロ融資案を提案
ja.body: 欧州委員会は2027年度のウクライナ向け新規450億ユーロ融資案を提案し、将来のロシア戦争賠償金から返済する計画だ。資金は均等に国防費と国家予算支出に割り当てられる。欧州委員会によると、資金はEU予算の利息から捻出される。

en.title: EU proposes 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine to be repaid from Russian reparations
en.dek: European Commission proposes new 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine, split evenly between defense and state budget spending, to be repaid through future Russian war reparations.
facts: European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine for 2027
The loan would be repaid through future Russian war reparations
The plan splits the funds evenly between defense and state budget spending
According to the Commission, the money would come from interest on the EU budget
Russia’s embassy in the Netherlands asked whether The Hague was openly joining the war after Dutch-headquartered defense company Destinus said its Ruta missiles struck the Crimean Bridge
The Dutch company confirmed the strike on the bridge linking annexed Crimea to Russia
body: The European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine for 2027, to be repaid through future Russian war reparations, the Commission said the money would come from interest on the EU budget.
The plan splits the funds evenly between defense and state budget spending, according to the Commission.

Russia’s embassy in the Netherlands asked whether The Hague was openly joining the war after Dutch-headquartered defense company Destinus said its Ruta missiles struck the Crimean Bridge, a Dutch company confirmed the strike on the bridge linking annexed Crimea to Russia.
The Kyiv Post reported that Russia questioned the Dutch role in the Crimean Bridge strike, asking whether The Hague was openly joining the war.
The Dutch company Destinus confirmed its Ruta missiles struck the Crimean Bridge, the bridge linking annexed Crimea to Russia.
The European Commission's proposal represents the latest financial commitment from the EU to Ukraine amid the ongoing conflict.
The loan mechanism ties repayment to future Russian war reparations, creating a framework for funding Ukraine's needs from Russian assets.
en.context: The European Union has been providing financial support to Ukraine since the beginning of the Russian invasion, with this latest proposal representing a significant new loan mechanism tied to potential Russian reparations. The Dutch company Destinus confirmed a strike on the Crimean Bridge, a key infrastructure link between annexed Crimea and Russia, which Russia has questioned as potentially involving Dutch participation in the conflict.
